verdict.rationale: No documentation in the evidence pack addresses robots.txt handling or content licensing terms at all. On permitted use, community evidence shows a real contradiction: Brave's free-tier ToS reportedly prohibits using API responses for 'AI inference,' yet Brave's own official guides promote integrating the API with AI agents (OpenClaw, Claude MCP, Dify) — users had to discover a separate paid 'AI Inference plan' to comply, undercutting a clear, consistent documented stance. missing for 10: any explicit robots.txt policy, any content licensing/reuse terms, and a consistent (non-contradictory) permitted-use statement.
